name: Bootstrap SQLite Inventory
description: Catalog every SQLite table, index, query, and access pattern in the current control plane. Document what each does and who calls it.
purpose: Know exactly what is being migrated before migrating it.
acceptanceCriteria: Every SQLite table in the control plane is catalogued with schema and row counts
Every index is identified with column composition
Every query pattern is documented with the calling context
Access patterns include caller identity and frequency
Inventory is stored as a structured document
